summary: Canonical dtype system and single source of truth for type vocabulary: MountainashDtype enum, parameterized descriptors (DecimalDtype, TimestampDtype, ListDtype, StructDtype, etc.), string parsing, a cast-safety table, and a lazy DtypeRegistry dispatching to per-target native adapters (polars, pyarrow, pandas, ibis, narwhals, python). Used for schema, cast and conversion lowering.
key_classes: DecimalDtype — parameterized exact-numeric descriptor with native lowering
NativeDtype — wrapper carrying a backend-native type refinement
DtypeRegistry — lazy dispatch façade over per-target adapters (module-level `registry`)
TypeTarget — enum of mapping targets with detect_target()
PolarsTypeAdapter / PyArrowTypeAdapter / PandasTypeAdapter / IbisTypeAdapter / NarwhalsTypeAdapter / PythonTypeAdapter — per-target mapping tables, imported lazily
NativeTypeAdapter / NativeArrowTransportAdapter — Protocol contracts for adapters
key_functions: parse_dtype(...) — parse a dtype string or object into canonical form
parse_cast_target(...) — parse a cast target including parameters
classify_cast(from_type, to_type) -> CastSafety / is_safe_cast(...) — cast safety lookup
detect_target(native) -> TypeTarget | None — identify which system a native dtype belongs to
portable_evidence(...) — portable structural evidence for a dtype
extension_points: NativeTypeAdapter Protocol (protocols.py): implement per target and register in DtypeRegistry
TypeTarget enum for adding a new native target
lifecycle_notes: c5fb334f retained temporal cast cardinality; f4333700 preserved source temporal parameters in expression casts.
838a285b moved shared schema declarations and adapter ownership; 9f2848d8 added DecimalDtype.
Type system unification (backlog 25) landed earlier via PRs #182-#185.
documentation_hooks: Type system reference: canonical dtypes and native mappings per backend
Extension guide: adding a native type adapter
risks: Per-target tables must stay complete for every MountainashDtype; incomplete mappings surface as DtypeMappingError at runtime (tests/core/dtypes/test_completeness.py guards).
Parameterized dtypes (decimal, timestamp, nested) have per-backend fidelity differences that are tested via regression locks.
typespec.universal_types is a separate Frictionless boundary vocabulary mapped onto this canon.

evidence.detail: __all__ lists dtype vocabulary, registry, casts and errors
